label: Карта
description: A 10-sentence usage card for карта (map; card).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Карта' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'висит'. 'Большая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'на стене' shows the place. A simple descriptive opener.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Карту' is the accusative direct object of 'взял'. The feminine ending shifts from -а to -у. 'В дорогу' explains the purpose. A practical travel sentence.

Strategic focus: Genitive under negation. 'Карты' is genitive after the negated 'нет', which always governs the genitive. 'Города' is also genitive showing of what. A core pattern for saying you lack something.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Карте' is dative after 'доверяю', a verb that governs the dative. 'Этой' is the agreeing feminine dative pronoun, and 'полностью' adds emphasis.

Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Картой' is instrumental, expressing the means of payment, here a bank card. 'В магазине' is prepositional, giving the place. A high-value everyday shopping sentence.

Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Карте' is the prepositional form after 'на', the surface on which something is marked. 'Красным' is instrumental showing the colour. A useful map-reading pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Карты' is the nominative plural subject. 'Эти' agrees in plural, and 'подробные' is the agreeing plural adjective. A good model for the feminine plural.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Карты' is the accusative plural; for inanimate feminine nouns the accusative copies the nominative plural form. 'Старые' agrees, and 'купили' is the verb of buying.

Strategic focus: Accusative with direction. 'Карту' is accusative after 'на' expressing motion toward, here adding money to a bank card. 'Деньги' is the accusative direct object. A practical banking sentence.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Карт' is the genitive plural after 'несколько', which governs the genitive. 'На столе' is prepositional, giving the place. A clean model for the zero-ending feminine plural.
